What a bite does

Widely cited as one of the fastest-acting venoms; untreated bites have historically caused death in under an hour to a few hours via respiratory paralysis.

Antivenom source. SAIMR polyvalent.

If you are bitten

Get to a hospital that holds antivenom. Keep still, remove rings and watches, and do not cut, suck or tie off the bite. Use the red “Bitten?” button at the top of any page.
